text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After receiving messages of support from
the
people of the shopping district, Nice
Nature aims
to answer their kind words
with victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, the Arima Kinen is a race that
gathers
powerhouses from each
generation, including
Мэдзиро МакКуин
and Мэдзиро Райан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It is a race that cannot be won with
ordinary
tactics. Determined to surpass
the other racers
and walk the path of a
main character, Nice
Nature makes for
the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
